correctness.rationale: Monotone translation-equivariant medians place output increments between input perturbation extrema on each window; on adjacent windows the oscillation bound sums over 2r+1 edges, counting each input edge 2r+1 times. Explicit interleaved ranks create alternating changes across a jump; a reflected second interface on any n≥8r cycle attains equality with epsilon<1. An exact standard-library checker was executed on 96 sharp instances and 2,400 sampled upper checks; finite checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: Exact nonlinear total-variation perturbation conditioning of a basic robust signal filter is a motivated functional-analytic invariant. For every window radius it has a sharp formula, nontrivial attaining examples and an increasing factor 2r+1 despite classical one-signal TV smoothing. It quantifies an operationally important distinction that cannot be recovered from input-wise TV diminution or sup-norm nonexpansivity.
